translationRepairs: Xiao Hui came with his son, Prince Su of Yidu, and his civil and military staff to the camp gate to surrender; Yuchi Jiong received them with full courtesy.
Xiao Hui came with Xiao Ji's son, Prince Su of Yidu, and his civil and military staff to the camp gate to surrender; Yuchi Jiong received them with full courtesy.
s0039 has 撝與紀子宜都王肅: 紀子 names Su as Xiao Ji's son, not Hui's; using Xiao Ji's full name corrects the kinship without leaving an ambiguous English reference.
Hui together with his son, Prince Su of Yidu, and his civil and military officials and attendants came to the camp gate to request audience; Jiong received them with ceremony.
Hui together with Xiao Ji's son, Prince Su of Yidu, and his civil and military officials and attendants came to the camp gate to request audience; Jiong received them with ceremony.
The same 紀子 in s0039 makes Su Xiao Ji's son; the literal “his son” wrongly attaches him to Hui, and the full name keeps the corrected kinship unambiguous.
Yang Jian ordered Yun Inspector-General Wang Yi as commander-in-chief and dispatched Jing-Xiang troops to suppress him.
Yang Jian ordered Xiang Inspector-General Wang Yi as commander-in-chief and dispatched Jing-Xiang troops to suppress him.
s0175 has 襄州總管王誼; 襄 is Xiang, not Yun, so “Xiang Inspector-General” correctly matches the Chinese office title.
From the crown prince against Tuyuhun, he fought hard and had merit.
He accompanied the crown prince against Tuyuhun, fought hard, and had merit.
s0113 從皇太子討吐谷渾 means he accompanied the crown prince on the campaign; “From the crown prince” misreads 從 and is ungrammatical, and the proposed literal restores that sense.
